snippet.title: God of War 2 | Full Game Walkthrough | PS3 | No Commentary
snippet.description:
God of War 2 Full Game Walkthrough on PS3. This God of War 2 Gameplay is recorded in 1080p on PS3 and will include the full game, all endings and all boss fights.

Enjoy!

If you liked the video don't forget to like and subscribe to the channel.
